offices.label: Bedford Law Group
offices.address: 10960 Wilshire Blvd Ste 750, Los Angeles, CA 90024, USA

about: Bedford Law Group is a personal injury firm with a single office in Los Angeles.
The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free. It publishes material in English and Spanish.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours and photo count come from the Places API. The owner's own description, the services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way. The API does expose Google's editorial summary, which is a different thing: Google writes those about notable places and has written one for no firm in this directory.

ahrefs.source: Ahrefs Site Explorer, batch endpoint, subdomains mode, organic figures for the United States

G1.source: the State Bar of California's licensee search
G1.evidence: 1 of 3 named attorneys hold an active California licence and none carries an adverse status. 2 name(s) could not be told apart from namesakes and are counted neither way

G2.source: the State Bar of California's licensee search
G2.evidence: No named attorney carries a disbarment, a suspension or a disciplinary resignation on the State Bar of California's record, across the 1 we identified. Administrative suspensions, which the State Bar states are non-disciplinary, are not counted here

G3.evidence: 1 physical location verified on Google Business Profile. California publishes no business register we are able to query, so the registration itself is not verified here. The state's own business search is the place to check it.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 2 named attorneys published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 165 public client reviews across 1 Google listing, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2012-11-11, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP

fee_statement: We handle car accident cases on a contingency fee basis so there are no upfront fees.

operating.source: Domain registration date over RDAP, which is a lower bound on how long the firm has been operating rather than its founding date

score.verdict: 4 of 5 eligibility gates passed. 1 could not be answered from the available records (G3) and does not count against the firm. Strongest pillar: C; most headroom in pillar B (0/15).

subs.label: Specificity
subs.evidence: 0 case types named; no court or county named, so no result can be looked up

subs.label: Results disclosure
subs.evidence: No prior-results disclaimer on the results page. A past result is not a prediction of another one, and the disclaimer is the sentence that says so

subs.label: Authentic volume
subs.evidence: 165 Google reviews · Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

subs.label: Rating quality
subs.evidence: Google rating 5.0 over 165 reviews → Bayesian 4.93 (prior 4.83 weighted as 100 reviews, from 1410 scored firms) · single platform, Google only

subs.label: Review recency
subs.evidence: 5 of 5 sampled reviews are from the last 12 months (newest 2026-05-01) · a sample of five per business listing, not every review

subs.label: Complaint share
subs.evidence: 0 of 5 sampled reviews rate 1 or 2 stars · a sample, so this is the shape of the complaints rather than a count of them

subs.label: Website trust & experience
subs.evidence: CWV fail · no fee statement · privacy policy · disclaimer · fresh content · scored out of 5 of the 7: nothing has measured accessibility or bar numbers on bios here yet, so it is not counted against this firm

subs.label: Search authority
subs.evidence: DR 4.9 → 30th pct of 141-firm cohort (median 13) 1/3 · 1,032 referring domains, 32th pct 1/2 · 40 organic keywords / 416 visits·mo, 58th pct 1/2 · brand demand 0/1 (pending)

subs.label: Local presence
subs.evidence: 1 operational Google Business Profile listing · 1 photos · 5 categories, hours published, which almost every listing here has and so separates nobody · the services list, Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the Places API does not expose, and NAP consistency across citations and local-pack rank have no source here, so the rest of this sub-factor leaves the scale rather than being scored as unearned

subs.label: Content, E-E-A-T & schema
subs.evidence: JSON-LD detected 1/1 · not assessed on any firm yet, so content depth and earned media and AI citations leave the scale (4 pts)

subs.label: Free consult & fee transparency
subs.evidence: Free consultation · “We handle car accident cases on a contingency fee basis so there are no upfront fees.” · the fee percentage itself is not published
